interpretation: Each company batch exhausts the connected GitHub search pagination for its query.
A repository may appear in more than one company projection.
Company relevance does not imply affiliation, employment, proprietary access, deployment, endorsement, or customer status.
Whole-estate census and company projections are separate concerns: a repo never disappears merely because it has no company edge.
Private repository identities and private company edges are omitted from this public projection.
The governed company universe comes from company_dossiers.json and all resolved shards; query-backed mesh groups enrich that authority rather than limiting it.

governed_company_authority.count_semantics: current governed observation, never a company ceiling
governed_company_authority.relationship_source: dossier repository rows plus runtime estate capability matching
governed_company_authority.runtime_attachment: all eligible reference systems with positive role-capability overlap remain attachable even when a dossier has zero direct repository rows

query_enrichment.semantics: query-backed enrichment edges for selected company families; not the company authority or company ceiling
